title: Performance Baseline
description: Establish speed benchmarks and fix low-hanging performance issues on client sites.

steps.title: Measure Core Web Vitals
steps.instructions: Run PageSpeed Insights or Lighthouse on homepage, a blog post, and a key landing page. Record LCP, INP, and CLS scores.

steps.title: Enable Object Cache
steps.instructions: Confirm Redis or Memcached object cache is active via drop-in or host feature. Verify with Query Monitor or host dashboard.

steps.title: Audit Autoloaded Options
steps.instructions: Identify oversized autoloaded options in wp_options. Clean up stale plugin data or move large blobs to non-autoload storage.

steps.title: Defer Non-Critical JavaScript
steps.instructions: Audit third-party scripts (chat widgets, pixels, heatmaps). Load them deferred or only on pages that need them.

steps.title: Optimize Web Fonts
steps.instructions: Self-host or preload critical font files. Limit font weights/styles loaded and use font-display: swap.

steps.title: Enable Lazy Loading
steps.instructions: Confirm native lazy loading is on for images. Add lazy load for below-fold iframes and embeds in page builder templates.

steps.title: Clean Post Revisions & Transients
steps.instructions: Remove excessive revisions, expired transients, and spam comments. Schedule recurring cleanup if the site is high-traffic.
